doc.title: Paul Shaffer interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, August 24, 2023

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Well this has been fantastic and I include myself in that group of envious musicians when we think about what you’ve accomplished and what you’re still — by the way, like when we wrap up here do you have a musical task to take care of?

Not today. No cats chomping at the bit today. But I make my own chores sometimes releasing what my beautiful assistant Olivia has certain Instagram mini-musicals. And sometimes, you know I get to flex my chops a little bit that way.
Excellent. Well thank you very much for your time, and I hope to see you on the flip side.
It’s been a gas, your name is Monk, I don’t think we have to say any more than that. Thank you, Monk, it’s been a lot of fun.
